title: Gemini availability per task tier — snapshot (#2041)
description: Written by scripts/gemini_tier_report.sh (gq_tier_snapshot in scripts/lib/gemini-quota.sh) on every fleet-monitor run and uploaded as the gemini-tier-snapshot artifact. Metered from the fleet ledger only. Keys are identified by INDEX only: no field may carry a key value. Read-only input for a later actuation change; nothing gates on it yet.

day_label.description: Reset-timezone date the current day window starts on (rolling-0 when the reset is not configured).

day_start.description: Epoch of the last daily reset (or now - 24h when rolling).

day_end.description: Epoch of the next daily reset; null when the reset is not configured (rolling 24h).

collection.description: What the snapshot was built from (#2147), added by scripts/gemini_tier_report.sh from the token report's collection report. gq_tier_decision answers unknown unless records is trusted-runs-only and complete is true.

complete.description: The filtered hand-off was written, every repository listing, listed artifact, needed run look-up and record file was read, and no handed-over record is unlisted.

records.description: trusted-runs-only: the records handed to this report were filtered to runs traceable to a trusted run.

reason.description: Why complete is false; empty when it is true.

run_lookups_failed.description: Artifacts whose uploading run could not be looked up (timeout, 403, rate limit): possibly real usage, left out. Above 0, complete is false.

record_files_malformed.description: Record files in downloaded artifacts that were not valid JSONL and were dropped. Above 0, complete is false.

gemini_records_unlisted.description: Handed-over records for a key index and model with no caps row: no production call writes them (test fixtures in the ledger). Above 0, complete is false.

key_index.description: 1 = primary slot (GEMINI_API_KEY / GOOGLE_API_KEY; 1b = a distinct GOOGLE_API_KEY), N = GOOGLE_API_KEY_N. Never a key value.

serving_model.description: The model the tier would run on now (null: none).

degraded_to.description: Set only when status is degraded: the later chain model that can run (a quality change).

remaining_calls.description: Sum over usable pairs; null when unknown or a usable pair has no daily cap.

recovers_at.description: When unavailable: earliest cooldown end or daily reset among the pairs.

used.description: Ledger counts (successes + rejected attempts) for the current windows — compare with the AI Studio viewer.
